method: Complete header and first350 lines of implementation read; verified full retained-file SHA256/Git blobs. Implementation is explicitly partial and gains no full-file credit.
findings: FTS interface distinguishes unreadable directory DNR, stat failure NS, traversal error ERR, cycle DC and missing symlink target SLNONE, with per-node errno. A caller must map these states explicitly to establish traversal completeness.

Header defaults path/name/count lengths to unsigned int, depth int, identity to platform inode/device types; these are not unrestricted size_t paths. Initial implementation helpers saturate length fields at UINT_MAX rather than proving arbitrary-long path support.
fts_open validates option mask and rejects zero-length path strings; logical traversal forces NOCHDIR. Root stat errors are retained as entry states rather than necessarily failing open.

Without NOCHDIR, open stores current-directory descriptor; failure falls back to NOCHDIR. Close attempts to restore cwd, saves restoration errno and returns -1 after releasing resources. Main callers must check close separately.
Beginning fts_read supports re-stat via AGAIN and returns NULL for finished or STOP condition. Remaining implementation must be reviewed before judging errno/termination semantics.
limits: No FTS runtime or filesystem mutation control.
